run_instruction_until_done: run a natural language instruction on the robot until success or timeout is reached
create_RunInstructionUntilDoneTool: create a RunInstructionUntilDoneTool with a success detector, run instruction tool, and optional stop tool
handle_tool_call_cancellation: handle cancellation events for an active run_instruction_until_done tool call by id
configure_minimum_run_duration: configure the RunInstructionUntilDoneTool to wait a minimum duration before returning success
configure_maximum_run_duration: configure the RunInstructionUntilDoneTool to set a timeout on the success detector tool
